messages:
Nina: I can't believe that last-minute FG. My lineup curse continues 
Raul: hah same. Loser of the pick'em still owes donuts tomorrow morning, right? 
Kelsey: yes! Loser brings a dozen. stakes are high for my caffeine budget. 
Ben: FYI I lost but I scored 2 points more than I thought. still the loser. someone remind me what counts as a loss in the app? 
Nina: app counts total points; tie-breaker is bench points. 
Raul: @Commissioner quick confirmation? 
Commissioner: Confirmed. Tie-breaker = bench points then bench rushing yards then coin flip. 
Kelsey: would accept bench rushing yards as a rule if it prevents coin flips forever. 
Ben: please no bench rushing yards comparisons, that gets weird. 
Nina: ok donuts: maple or glazed? vote with emoji. 
OpsBot: Poll: "Donut type" options: :maple:, :glazed:, :sprinkles:. React :one:, :two:, or :three:. Poll closes in 2 hours. 
Raul: :three: sprinkles for visibility. 
Kelsey: :two: glazed please. 
Ben: :two: glazed. Also can we move the pickup to 8:45 so I have time to shower and not smell locker room? 
Nina: 8:45 works for me. Ben you owe us a funny GIF as penalty for losing. 
Ben: prepared: https://giphy.com/fumble-gif 
Commissioner: Quick note for keeper league: remember keeper lock is at midnight tomorrow. You can't drop or trade keepers after that. 
Raul: important. I'm locking my keeper tonight. 
Kelsey: paste of keeper rule for reference: 
```
Keeper settings: lock at 00:00 UTC on Monday of Week 9. Trades that transfer keeper status are blocked after lock.
``` 
Ben: ok locking now. also will bring donuts. 
Nina: thanks! GIF: https://giphy.com/donut-victory 
OpsBot: Poll closed. Results: sprinkles 1, glazed 2, maple 0. "glazed" selected. Pickup scheduled 8:45am tomorrow at lobby coffee station. 
Raul: see you there. Whoever ate the last stale office donut last month owes triple. 
Kelsey: triple or nothing.
